name: Krant
description: Krant was a wilderness planet in the Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. It saw action from the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War, and the Jedi Master Echuu Shen-Jon hid on Krant during decades until Princess Leia Organa appeared on the planet, searching for the Bothan agent Utric Sandov.
lead_paragraphs: Krant was a wilderness planet in the Bothan Space in the Mid Rim. It saw action from the Clone Wars and the Galactic Civil War, and the Jedi Master Echuu Shen-Jon hid on Krant during decades until Princess Leia Organa appeared on the planet, searching for the Bothan agent Utric Sandov.
